They require level 40 [[Ranged]] to be worn. This item is a considerable choice for rangers in [[free-to-play]] servers, as well as for [[melee]] combat because they have higher total defence bonuses than either [[leather gloves]] or [[leather vambraces]] while having no negative melee attack bonuses. However, they should not be used for [[magic]] combat due to the substantial negative magic attack bonus. They offer the highest ranged accuracy bonus among [[free-to-play]] hand slot items, although their defensive bonuses are surpassed by the [[gilded d'hide vambraces]]. Notable for no [[Defence]] requirement, these vambraces are commonly used by the [[Free-to-play combat pure guide|free-to-play combat pures]]. The aforementioned negative magic bonus has the effect of making this item popular for [[splashing]] in [[free-to-play]] servers since it is one of the only ways, along with [[Gilded d'hide vambraces]], to reach the required -64 Magic attack bonus without using the [[cursed goblin staff]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -10 |arange = +8
